synthesis_scope.qd: The source describes core growth, Zn/S stock formulations, alternating shell additions and MPA exchange; durations, shell charges/monolayers and exchange conditions are missing. The 3.8 nm value belongs to the water-soluble product, not an independently measured core.
synthesis_scope.au: Au reduction is a partial method citing reference 32; source main specifies HAuCl4·3H2O/NaBH4 and 3 nm result but no dosing, solvent, stabilizer or isolation.
synthesis_scope.dna: Two separate ten-base thiolated strands; three T–T mismatches in the paired design. Average loading is 4 DNA/QD and 1 DNA/Au estimated by optical absorption. No complete functionalization protocol supplied.
synthesis_scope.si: Main associated-content statement lists TEM/XPS characterization and SI Figures S1–S9; those images are not part of this contribution. No morphology/phase inferred from sensor cartoons.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Preparation and Results

mechanistic_context.NSET: Authors attribute Hg-triggered quenching to nanoparticle surface energy transfer following DNA-mediated proximity.
mechanistic_context.recognition: T–Hg(II)–T coordination permits hybridization across three designed thymine mismatches.
mechanistic_context.no_Hg_case: Main attributes lack of hybridization to electrostatic repulsion between the negatively charged DNA strands.
mechanistic_context.QD_only_control: Main reports no observable quenching when Hg(II) is added to QDs without Au, citing SI Figure S8; underlying SI control not inspected.

model_comparisons.scope: Literature explanatory model; short wavefunction-overlap distance 0.5–1 nm cited.
Literature comparison, typical distance up to 10 nm and spectral-overlap requirement.
Source mechanism interpretation; related study ref. 40 reports distance dependence and quenching up to approximately 6.2 nm. No current sample-specific distance label inferred.

historical_regulatory_comparison.qualification: Values quoted by this 2011 paper only, not verified current regulatory guidance.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–3, Introduction and mechanism discussion

source_interpretation.text: The authors use MPA exchange to disperse the hydrophobic synthesis product in water and report dispersion for up to one month. Exchange conditions and quantitative stability criteria are not supplied.

The authors design thymine mismatches so Hg(II)-mediated coordination brings QD and Au probes close enough for fluorescence quenching. This is their NSET interpretation; the paper does not supply an atomistic interface model.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Results and mechanism discussion

source_interpretation.text: The source reports a higher detection limit and lower initial fluorescence in river water than in pure PBS, attributing the difference to environmental substances.

The authors propose on-site monitoring and future multi-ion detection using differently emitting QDs excited by one light source. These remain outlooks, not a demonstrated multianalyte device in this paper.
